items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: I was a trombone player on Al Wagner's show, Al Wagner's carnival.

ctx.x: I don't know one from the other.

Well I was a trombone player on Al Wagner's show. Do you remember where they were from? Mobile, Alabama. Mobile. I was a trombone player on Al Wagner's show, Al Wagner's carnival. And I was also a trombone player on Sammy Green's minstrel show.
Yeah, I've heard of that. How did most of these shows travel? On the train or trucks? In those days what did they do?
